flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democrats to take the Senate improved moderately, with the party remaining the market's favoured side. In [[Michigan]], the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed gained moderate ground. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts saw a moderate drop in their chances.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Nebraska]], where the Republican Jim Pillen saw a sharp rise in Polymarket odds. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained a sizable amount of ground, and the market treats the race as a predicted flip. Moderate gains for the Republicans Greg Abbott and Byron Donalds also showed up in Texas and Florida.
summaries.house: The projected House count has shifted to 239-196, up from 238-197, and the market says Democrats gain control, with [[WI-01 (Kenosha & Racine)]] newly predicted as a flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp drop in their chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], the Republican Dan Green gained sizable ground, and the market treats it as a predicted flip.
